com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Replace a load's truck and odometer details. Optional values left out are cleared; an omitted empty-distance override may still be derived by IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: For our selected fictional practice load, preview replacing vehicle details with truck DEMO-TRUCK, starting odometer 10000 km, closing odometer 10400 km and empty distance 50 km. Show the complete replacement and wait for my confirmation.

annotations.title: Record a load's truck and km

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_set_load_vehicle, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare replacing the truck/odometer record. Omitted optional vehicle fields are cleared; empty km can remain derived. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
